column1: # The position table of targets/chromeos.md (rule code): the DOM KeyboardEvent code value ChromeOS reports for each
# position, in chrome.input.ime's KeyboardEvent.code ("the physical key being pressed ... not affected by current
# keyboard layout or modifier state"). Position names are the W3C code values (SPEC §6.1), so every row is the
# identity: the table lists which positions have a code.
#   w3c = W3C "UI Events KeyboardEvent code Values" (https://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-code/), the code values Chrome
#         reports; the rows are the positions of targets/xkb-default-keyname.tsv, whose codes come from Chromium's
#         ui/events/keycodes/dom/dom_code_data.inc (BSD-3-Clause), the table Chrome and ChromeOS take code values from
# SysRq and Break (targets/windows-default-vk.tsv) have no W3C code value and no row.
